title: N58: International equity VT — 8/8 MaxDD improvement (avg +27pp), corr 0.947 with base risk
description: Tested GARCH VT on 8 international equity ETFs (EWJ, EWG, EWU, EWA, EWZ, EEM, VGK, EWT) for 2020-2025. MaxDD improved for ALL 8 (avg +27.1pp, range 14-52pp). Brazil most dramatic: -72.6% → -20.3%. But Sharpe decreased for ALL 8 (avg -0.14) — the pure risk-reduction trade-off without VIX switching. Correlation(base_MDD, MDD_improvement)=0.947, almost perfectly replicating SPY finding (rho=0.983).
